situation.zh: 邻居们在院子里摆了一桌共食,每家带一道菜。有人招手让你过去。你想加入,并说明你能带什么。
situation.en: The neighbours have set out a shared meal in the yard, and each household brings a dish. Someone waves you over. You want to join and say what you can bring.

npc.persona: A neighbour arranging plates on the long table. Warm, chatty, glad of one more.
npc.greeting: Come over. There is more than enough.

hit: You will bring rice next time? Perfect. Sit down, eat first. We do this every Sunday.
Join us, of course. And bring something next week if you like. Plates are at the end.
partial: You are joining? And what was the other part?
I did not quite get all of it. Say it again?

slots.zh_hint: 说明你能带什么 / 能帮什么(共食的规矩是各出一份)
问一句关于他们的事(把交流变成双向的)

reference_answer: Can I join you? I will bring rice next time.

provenance.rationale: 邻里、同事、同学之间的共食是形成归属感最常见的场合,而「各带一份」的默认规矩意味着加入不只是被邀请,还要说出自己出什么。这一条把归属从「被允许」推进到「有来有往」。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 3 层(归属)。join / bring / rice / next time 均为日常高频词;youth 级要求同时交付加入意愿与自己的贡献,「i come, i bring rice」即算传达到。
